brief: Keep Mara's bakery story and the testimonial style, but make the product and its value clear: the problem she had, what she uses now, how it helps her manage the weekly staff schedule, and the result. Drop the word 'rota' - it is British jargon for a staff schedule and it was also the product name, so the product is renamed Crew and the script says 'staff schedule' in plain words.
why_only_four_new_shots: This is a revision, not a new film. Two of the four original dialogue takes say nothing that changed - line 1 sets up the bakery, line 3 lists the interruptions - so they are reused verbatim, along with all four b-roll plates. Only the lines whose words change are re-bought. Reusing them also guarantees continuity: every new line is generated from the same reference frame the originals came from, so it is the same woman throughout.
length_rule: Shot duration is matched to the line using 0.48 seconds per word, the rate measured across the four verified takes of the previous loop. The previous loop's only failure came from over-buying time: given three spare seconds the model padded by restarting the clause. Every line below sits between 0.7 and 1.8 seconds of spare room, the band the successful takes occupied.
